Closest positive source analogue is small microphagous/omnivorous pelagic sardine pair7/8. Milkfish/flyingfish/halfbeak habitat, diet, size and reproductive strategy differ materially; no exact local source compartment or SAU stage fractions are available. Sardines7/8 provide the closest mixed microphagous/omnivorous pelagic connection among source small-pelagic pools. Anchovies6 and mackerels9/10/scads11/12 emphasize other plankton/prey mixtures; reef herbivores18 have a benthic reef feeding/habitat mismatch. None is an exact taxonomic fit; the sardine cutoff10.5 cm is not claimed to define this taxon. The two source-pool catch weights are an ecological analogue mixture, not its measured juvenile/adult fractions.
